claims.claim: 4 Gas cooker and 2 burner making 6 burner in total
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows four gas burners plus one central round electric hotplate, totaling five cooking zones, not six.
Photo 0 and 2 show missing/mismatched control knobs, which cannot be 'working perfectly' as stated.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows surface grime and an improvised (non-original) oven door handle, inconsistent with light, recent use.
Missing knobs and improvised handle visible in Photo 0 and Photo 2 indicate prior faults or wear.
No internal or mechanical view provided; gas cookers of this type typically have no 'motor' to open, so claim cannot be checked from photos.
No photo of receipt or warranty card provided.

risks.risk: Oven bake/grill function may not work
risks.proof: Video of oven heating element glowing and thermostat dial turning during a bake cycle
risks.if_unproven: price as oven non-functional, cooktop-only value

risks.proof: Photo or clip of the central hotplate glowing red when switched on

risks.risk: Gas leakage or faulty ignition on unlit burners
risks.proof: Video showing all four gas burners igniting cleanly without smell of gas or delayed ignition
risks.if_unproven: price as two-burner functional unit only (since only two were shown lit)

risks.risk: Missing knobs may indicate missing or broken control valves, not just cosmetic
risks.proof: Close-up photo of all control shafts showing knobs can be fitted and turn smoothly
risks.if_unproven: price as missing-parts unit needing knob replacement

risks.risk: Exposed wiring near hotplate could be an electrical safety hazard
risks.proof: Close-up photo of wiring/connection points behind or under the hotplate

risks.risk: True age may be older than one year, affecting wear and remaining lifespan
risks.proof: Photo of receipt/warranty card with visible purchase date
risks.if_unproven: price as unknown-age used unit, not near-new

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the receipt and warranty card with legible date
Video of all four gas burners igniting and burning steadily
Video of the electric hotplate heating to visible red/orange
Video of oven interior heating with door open, showing bake and grill elements
Close-up of knob shafts/valves to assess if replacement knobs would fit and function
Photo of wiring/connections near the hotplate for safety check
response.reason: The item type is clear (gas cooker with oven and hotplate), but seller's claims of full functionality and 'barely used' are contradicted by visible missing knobs, grime, and an improvised handle, so it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
